summary: Four dedicated UITests drive real app+model state machine (no-project/loading via FIFO gate/clean-tree/git-failure) each asserting a distinct unique title text and absence of the 'Files' stat card that only renders in the populated-summary branch (DiffTotalsView), which is the sole place 'Files' is emitted in DiffPaneView.swift; git subprocess is stubbed via env hooks but the state-selection/view logic under test is exercised unmocked.
